work.abstract_text: We answer Question 9.3 of Luo, McCullough and Tsikalas, Beurling Criteria for Reproducing Kernels, arXiv:2607.25088v2 (2026), page 45, negatively on a three-point set: a rank-two source kernel forces constant full interpolation data, while positive retraction quotients extend every proper datum at every matrix size. The source kernel is non-vanishing, the target kernel is strictly positive definite, and their entrywise quotient has quadratic form -10/33 at (-2,1,1). Three points and source rank two are minimal. A diagonal perturbation gives a one-parameter family with the same negative answer. The family is neither complete Pick, Beurling–Lax–Halmos, complete pseudo-Leech, nor weakly Agler-decomposable.

authors.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore
authors.name: Wenlin Zhang

work.title: A three-point negative answer to Luo–McCullough–Tsikalas's pseudo-Pick quotient question
